llm_reason: Baseline diagnosis (R1 evaluate): ED 400.8 close but below 446.18 (mass 43.5 g > 40 g); 5C retention 8.7% catastrophically low - solid-diffusion limited (D_s,pos=4e-15 m2/s, r=5.22 um -> tau~6800 s). Opening ceiling assessment: thin collectors (Al 8 um/Cu 6 um, literature high-ED cell practice) cut inactive mass 0.1506->0.0779 kg/m2 => ED(f)=17.41f/(0.2699f+0.0779) reaches 446 at f>=0.68; all variants mass < 40 g. 5C fix = physical levers only: particle radius (r^2/D scaling; nano NMC ~1.5 um literature high-power practice; neg 2 um fine graphite), electrolyte transport formulation (sigma 1.3 S/m literature high-conductivity LiPF6 EC/EMC; D 4e-10 m2/s literature range; t+ 0.45 ESTIMATE high-transference formulation - marked estimate, not simulation output). Nominal cell capacity set self-consistent (5.0/4.0/3.4 Ah = 5 Ah x f) so '5C' protocol is a true 5C rate (mislabeled-current trap avoided; will verify |actual-nominal|<=3%). N/P ratio preserved (1.127). Funnel: no molecular candidates (architecture+formulation only; t+ and D are formulation candidates with literature/estimate source, no funnel needed per protocol table).
